name: AIRS-Bench
intro: AIRS-Bench 用 20 项任务评测科研 Agent 的端到端机器学习研究能力。它先人工核验约 100 项候选的 SOTA、指标与切分，再以难度分层和子集优化保留来自 17 篇论文、16 个数据集的 7 类任务；Agent 在隐藏测试标签、无基线代码、24 小时单张 H200 的条件下运行。
build_method: PapersWithCode候选筛选、人工SOTA/指标/切分核验、四难度带子集优化、保真验证与双框架任务封装
metric: 平均有效提交率；march-of-9s平均归一化分数；Bradley-Terry拟合Elo
eval_feature: 端到端科研、无基线与隐藏测试标签、SOTA信息隐藏、每任务-Agent至少10次运行
build_method_en: PapersWithCode screening, manual SOTA/metric/split verification, four-band subset optimization, fidelity validation, and dual-harness task packaging
eval_feature_en: End-to-end research, no baseline, hidden test labels and SOTA information, at least 10 runs per task-agent
intro_en: AIRS-Bench evaluates end-to-end machine-learning research agents on 20 tasks. It manually verifies SOTA values, metrics, and splits for roughly 100 candidates, then uses difficulty stratification and subset optimization to retain tasks from 17 papers and 16 datasets across seven categories. Agents run with hidden test labels, no baseline code, and a 24-hour single-H200 budget.
metric_en: Mean valid submission rate, march-of-9s average normalized score, and Bradley-Terry-fitted Elo
drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2602.06855v3 §4, §5, Appendix A, and facebookresearch/airs-bench@18e4f1d501069cf7d7e2740d81c2ca748c56a6a1. PapersWithCode candidates are screened for 2020-2025 SOTA, dataset availability, and train/test splits; curators then verify the reported SOTA value, metric, and identical splits. Roughly 100 tasks from about 85 papers and datasets are ranked into four difficulty bands of about 25. Four allocations crossed with random search (10,000 samples), simulated annealing, and a genetic algorithm yield 12 searches. The selected GA medium-skewed {4,7,5,4} suite has MAE 4e-3; its agent mean-score difference from the full pool never exceeds 0.02, with 95% confidence intervals and ranking preserved. The 20-task release spans 17 papers, 16 datasets, and seven categories. Task packages include metadata.yaml, project_description.md, prepare.py, evaluate_prepare.py, evaluate.py, and optional utils.py for AIRA-dojo/MLGym. Runs receive no baseline or SOTA method/score, use hidden test labels, last 24 hours on one H200, and repeat at least 10 times per task-agent. The paper reports VSR, march-of-9s normalized score with failed/invalid submissions set to zero, and per-task pairwise Bradley-Terry Elo with human SOTA as an opponent.
